name: Input / AI Prompt
description: AI Prompt product scenario for the Input component.

props.label: System instruction
props.placeholder: Describe how the assistant should behave...

controls.name: placeholder
controls.description: Hint while empty; use label or aria-label for the accessible name.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Exclude the field from editing, focus navigation, and form submission.

controls.name: readOnly
controls.description: Prevent edits while preserving focus, selection, and form submission.

controls.name: required
controls.description: Require a value for native form validation and show the required indicator.

controls.name: name
controls.description: Field key used by native FormData.

controls.name: spellCheck
controls.description: Browser spelling assistance for editable text.

controls.name: autoFocus
controls.description: Focus the control on mount.

controls.name: autoComplete
controls.description: Native autocomplete token, such as email or current-password.

controls.name: minLength
controls.description: Minimum length for native text validation.

controls.name: maxLength
controls.description: Maximum length for native text entry.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Controlled value. User edits notify callbacks; the parent owns the result.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Uncontrolled initial value, also restored by form reset.

controls.name: label
controls.description: Visible label associated with the native control.

controls.name: description
controls.description: Help associated with the native control. Empty content adds no spacing or ARIA id.

controls.name: error
controls.description: Validation message; also marks the control invalid unless aria-invalid is explicit.

controls.name: labelOrientation
controls.description: Label placement; has no effect without a label.

controls.name: icon
controls.description: Decorative icon from the registry or a custom element.

controls.name: iconPosition
controls.description: Icon at inline start or end, following the control's text direction.

controls.name: clearable
controls.description: Offer a clear action for a nonempty, editable field.

controls.name: clearLabel
controls.description: Accessible name of the clear action.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Outer spacing around the native control, independent of label and help.

controls.name: multiline
controls.description: Use a native textarea, including newline entry and textarea form behavior.

controls.name: type
controls.description: Native single-line type. Multiline fields always use textarea text semantics.

controls.name: min
controls.description: Lower bound for numeric or temporal input types.

controls.name: max
controls.description: Upper bound for numeric or temporal input types.

controls.name: step
controls.description: Numeric or temporal increment; use any to allow arbitrary precision.

controls.name: pattern
controls.description: Native regular expression for single-line text validation.

controls.name: list
controls.description: Datalist id for native single-line suggestions.

controls.name: multiple
controls.description: Allow several addresses when type is email.

controls.name: rows
controls.description: Minimum visible rows. A fixed row count when autoGrow is false.

controls.name: autoGrow
controls.description: Grow and shrink a multiline field with its content and available width.
